title: [WIP] Migrate content from revvel-standards to docs/soup2bowl
body:
- [x] Explore revvel-standards for Soul2Bowl specifications (BLUEPRINT.md, BRAND.md, SEO_STRATEGY.md, ROADMAP.md)
- [ ] Migrate all Soul2Bowl docs from revvel-standards to `docs/soup2bowl/`
- [ ] Scaffold Next.js 14 project with App Router + Tailwind CSS
- [ ] Configure glassmorphic design system with brand colors (Warm Gold, Deep Teal, Flame Orange, Deep Obsidian)
- [ ] Build shared layout: nav, footer, glassmorphic theme
- [ ] Build Homepage (`/`) — hero, about snippet, services, menu preview, eco section, testimonials
- [ ] Build Menu page (`/menu`) — full menu with dietary filters
- [ ] Build Order page (`/order`) — calendar-based ordering
- [ ] Build Catering page (`/catering`) — service overview, booking form
- [ ] Build About page (`/about`) — chef bio, story, video embed
- [ ] Build Blog page (`/blog`) — SEO-targeted articles
- [ ] Build Contact page (`/contact`) — contact form + map
- [ ] Add Framer Motion animations (hero steam, card hover, page transitions)
- [ ] Add SEO metadata per page (generateMetadata, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt)
- [ ] Set up .env.example, .mcp.json, LICENSE

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> Review everything in revvel-standards and follow all the requirements then migrate to docs/soup2bowl eerything should be in there you need. i do want to use those sayings here or there. and i have included real pics of her food t be made better. and pics really good pics. of her to use with info about her in the images.  create the website 
> 
> 
> 
> For Soul2Bowl, a modern glassmorphic aesthetic combined with high-end, realistic food photography will create a "top-tier" feel that balances tech-forward design with the warmth of a Sunday dinner.
> 
> Here is a comprehensive design concept and structural breakdown for your website.
> 
> 🎨 The Visual Identity: "Frost & Fire"
> The goal is to make the interface look like a pane of frosted glass floating over a warm, bustling kitchen or a perfectly set Sunday table.
> 
> Element	Specification
> Glass Effect	Semi-transparent white cards with backdrop-filter: blur(20px) and a subtle 1px white border.
> Typography	Header: Cormorant Garamond (Elegant Serif). Body: Inter (Clean, Modern Sans-Serif).
> Color Palette	Deep Charcoal (Text), Warm Amber (Accents/Action buttons), Soft Cream (Background highlights).
> Imagery	High-resolution, shallow depth-of-field "hero" shots (e.g., steam rising from a braised short rib).
> 🏗️ Website Structure
> 1. The Hero Section (The "First Impression")
> Background: A high-fidelity, slow-motion video of a Sunday dinner being served—wine pouring, bread being torn, laughter in soft focus.
> 
> Foreground: A centered glassmorphic card containing:
> 
> Headline: Tradition, Reimagined for the Modern Table.
> 
> CTA Buttons: [ Book Catering ] (Solid Amber) and [ View Meal Plans ] (Glass Ghost Button).
> 
> 2. Sunday Dinners (The Soul)
> This section uses a Horizontal Scroll layout with glass cards for each "Menu of the Month."
> 
> Visual: Each card features a "floating" realistic PNG of a signature bowl (e.g., a deconstructed Sunday Roast).
> 
> Interaction: Hovering over a card increases the "frosted" blur and reveals the full ingredient list.
> 
> 3. Meal Planning Dashboard (The Tech)
> A clean, grid-based "Glass UI" where users can drag and drop meals into their weekly calendar.
> 
> Feature: A sidebar that calculates nutritional macros in real-time using a subtle glowing progress bar.
> 
> 💻 Conceptual Design Prompt
> If you are using an AI image generator (like Midjourney or DALL-E) to visualize the homepage, use this prompt:
> 
> UI/UX Design Prompt: A high-end website landing page for "Soul2Bowl". Modern Glassmorphism style. Background is a hyper-realistic, professional food photography shot of a gourmet Sunday dinner with warm lighting and soft bokeh. The UI features frosted glass cards with soft shadows, elegant serif typography, and amber accent buttons. 8k resolution, clean layout, luxury aesthetic, minimalist navigation bar.
> 
> 🛠️ Recommended Tech Stack (2026 Standards)
> To achieve the performance required for high-res imagery and glass effects:
> 
> Frontend: Next.js 16 with Tailwind CSS (utilizing backdrop-blur utilities).
> 
> Animations: Framer Motion for the "floating" effect of the glass panels.
> 
> CMS: Sanity.io or Contentful to easily swap out seasonal Sunday menus.
> 
> Hosting: Vercel for lightning-fast global edge delivery of your realistic images.
> 
> Would you like me to draft the specific Menu Copy for your first Sunday Dinner offering?


</details>
